description: This file contains integration tests for loan repayment schedules with down payment configurations in the Fineract platform. It defines various test cases that create loan products with down payment settings, approve loans, disburse funds, and verify repayment schedules including down payment, charges, and interest considerations.

classes.name: LoanRepaymentScheduleWithDownPaymentTest
classes.description: This class contains integration tests for verifying the loan repayment schedule functionality with various down payment configurations. It extends BaseLoanIntegrationTest to utilize common setup and utility methods.

methods.name: loanRepaymentScheduleWithSimpleDisbursementAndDownPayment
methods.description: Test case for verifying repayment schedule with a simple disbursement and down payment enabled.

methods.name: loanRepaymentScheduleWithSimpleDisbursementAndAutoRepaymentDownPayment
methods.description: Test case for verifying repayment schedule with auto-repayment for down payment enabled.

methods.name: loanRepaymentScheduleWithMultiDisbursementProductOneDisbursementAndDownPayment
methods.description: Test case for multiple disbursement scenarios with down payment.

methods.name: loanRepaymentScheduleWithMultiDisbursementProductTwoDisbursementAndDownPayment
methods.description: Test case for two disbursements with down payment, verifying schedule and amounts.

methods.name: loanRepaymentScheduleWithMultiDisbursementProductTwoDisbursementAndAutoReaymentDownPayment
methods.description: Test case for two disbursements with auto-repayment down payment, checking schedule and balances.

methods.name: loanRepaymentScheduleWithMultiDisbursementProductOneDisbursementAndThreeRepaymentsAndDownPayment
methods.description: Test for schedule with one disbursement, three repayments, and down payment.

methods.name: loanRepaymentScheduleWithMultiDisbursementProductTwoDisbursementAndThreeRepaymentsAndDownPayment
methods.description: Test for schedule with two disbursements, three repayments, and down payment, including schedule verification.

methods.name: loanRepaymentScheduleWithMultiDisbursementProductTwoDisbursementAndThreeRepaymentsAndDownPaymentAndCharge
methods.description: Test case introducing charges and verifying impact on schedule and amounts.

methods.name: loanRepaymentScheduleWithChargeAndDownPayment
methods.description: Test schedule considering charges along with down payment setup.

methods.name: loanRepaymentScheduleWithChargeAndInterestAndDownPayment
methods.description: Test schedule with charges, interest, and down payment.

methods.name: loanRepaymentScheduleWithMultiDisbursementProductTwoDisbursementAndThreeRepaymentsAndDownPaymentAndChargeAndInterest
methods.description: Complex schedule test with disbursements, charges, interest, and down payments.

methods.name: testDelinquencyRangeOnDownPaymentInstallment
methods.description: Test to verify delinquency range detection on a down payment installment, including business date manipulation.

methods.name: loanApplicationCreationWithLoanProductWithEnableDownPaymentConfiguration
methods.description: Test creating a loan application with a loan product configured with down payment enabled.

methods.name: loanApplicationWithLoanProductWithEnableDownPaymentConfigurationDoesNotChangeWithUpdateProductConfiguration
methods.description: Test which verifies that down payment configuration does not change when the loan product configuration is updated.
